title: Bond distance is graph distance plus one in the plane
claim: On the triangular lattice under NAE on every triangle (the ground states of the triangular Ising antiferromagnet): every pair of sites is free and the non-free triples are exactly the triangles; for sites u != v at graph distance d the least bond containing both has d + 2 sites; every site is flipped by a finite change at the flat three-class state.
failure_conditions: Two sites at distance d with a bond of fewer than d + 2 sites containing both (against R2's lower bound).
Two sites at distance d with no bond of d + 2 sites containing both (against R2's upper bound).
A tie, or a non-free triple that is not a triangle (against R1).
A site of the flat three-class state that no finite change flips (against R3).
foundation_claim_scope: The infinite triangular lattice with NAE on every triangle; finite bonds of the set of all allowed states; the source label at one solution. Flat tori and Klein bottles are not claimed.

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the coordinator's go-ahead on 2026-11-11; read by an independent referee (a fresh Claude agent given the proof and the code) with its own SAT oracles on a disc and a torus, which found R1 to R3 fully proved.
validation.status: proved by hand; finite checks in check.py passed (result.json); refereed, sound, with presentational fixes made
validation.novelty: known-with-delta: the height mapping of the triangular Ising antiferromagnet's ground states and the extension of height functions by difference constraints are known; R1 to R3 as statements on the minimal non-shattered sets were not found in a bounded search; folklore risk moderate.
